jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Enterprise Products
jobs.description:
1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access. We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.



But we're going further. Over 75,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 1 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.



We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.



About Payer & Patient Outcomes at Headway

Headway's relationship with payers is evolving from a credentialing and billing partnership to something far more valuable: a network that can prove what it delivers and build products purpose-built for how health plans actually operate. The Payer & Patient Outcomes team owns that transformation — building the products, data infrastructure, and measurement frameworks that let Headway walk into a payer conversation with more than access to sell.

About this role

As Enterprise Product Manager, Payer, you'll own the product layer that turns Headway's relationships with its largest payer accounts into differentiated, enterprise-grade product — not one-off features built to placate a single account, but capabilities that create real leverage in contracting and open new ways for payers to engage with Headway. You'll work in lockstep with our Payer BD/Commercial team, translating what actually moves a deal into product requirements, and with Data and Engineering to ship it. This is a build-from-scratch mandate: there's no existing enterprise-product playbook here, and part of the job is creating one.

What You'll Own

 - Enterprise-tier products built in direct partnership with named strategic payer accounts — the kind of capability that's a genuine reason a payer signs, renews, or expands with Headway

 - The product-side relationship with Payer BD: translating commercial asks into requirements, and pushing back or reshaping them when a better path exists

 - A repeatable framework for enterprise payer product work, so builds for one payer become reusable rather than bespoke

 - Navigating enterprise buying process (procurement, legal, multi-stakeholder sign-off) without importing enterprise pace into how the team builds internally

You'd be a great fit if…

 - You've operated as a Staff-level PM inside a real enterprise sales motion — you understand what makes a large, slow-moving institutional buyer actually move, and you're comfortable being evaluated by procurement and legal, not just end users

 - You can hold enterprise rigor and startup urgency at the same time — you don't use "enterprise" as an excuse to slow down

 - You can generalize a single account's specific ask into something reusable, rather than shipping a one-off every time

 - You've built trust and gotten cross-functional partners (Engineering, Data, BD) to prioritize your work without having authority over their roadmaps

 - Healthcare/payer experience is a plus, not a requirement — what matters more is that you've already proven this pace-vs.-rigor tension somewhere else

jobs.description:

Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access. We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. But we're going further. Over 75,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 1 million patients. We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.




ABOUT THE ROLE

At Headway, we're building the future of behavioral health — and increasingly, that means shipping products that providers and patients rely on every day. We're hiring a Clinical Product Lead to own the clinical judgment behind how risk gets detected, escalated, and closed out across our platform, and to make sure every product surface we build is connected to the safety systems behind it.

Headway already has real safety capability through risk detection, human triage, a 24/7 crisis partner, and more. However as our platform expands, particularly into AI tooling, so does our need for a single coherent system and point of ownership for patient safety across product surfaces.

This role sits on our Clinical Product team, partnering daily with engineering, product, and clinical operations. You'll also carry the clinical safety bar for our AI surfaces.

This is a first-of-its-kind role. You'll help define what "safe" means for a behavioral health platform operating at the scale of our network — and then build the products and systems that make it true rather than aspirational.




YOU WILL:

 - Own the clinical requirements for how patient risk is detected and mitigated through our platform surfaces including the patient portal, support chat and phone, clinical assessments, conversational intake, and more. Drive us toward one shared severity taxonomy and routing model.

 - Serve as the Clinical Product Patient Safety partner for product features that carry the potential for risk disclosure. Define safety requirements and safeguards, integrate the product into existing escalations structures, and red-team the failure points. Stay with the feature after launch to review how the safeguards performed.

 - Audit our product surfaces to identify patient safety gaps. Collaborate within the clinical team and with cross functional partners to close those gaps.

 - Support us in holding the clinical safety and quality bar for our AI surfaces such as AI-generated clinical notes, treatment planning, and conversational tools. Write rubrics, label the gold-standard cases our models learn from, and audit model output against your own clinical assessment.

 - Resolve risk-ownership questions and ensure that our policies and the platform clearly and accurately reflect that position.

 - Communicate tradeoffs clearly to non-clinical stakeholders — including when speed, scale, or automation must be balanced against clinical rigor — and push back constructively when product or technical decisions conflict with sound clinical judgment.
   
   


YOU WILL LOVE THIS ROLE IF:

 - You are an Independently Licensed Therapist (LPC, LCSW, PhD, or PsyD) with 3+ years of post-graduate clinical experience.

 - You have worked inside a safety or quality system and feel extremely confident in risk assessment and safety planning, and crisis response.

 - You are a systems thinker. You can look at a set of disconnected escalation paths and see the single model underneath.

 - You thrive working quickly and cross-functionally with engineers, product partners, and operations teams. You're comfortable saying "what you’re proposing carries some risk, and here's the clinical reason why," and you know how to make that feedback actionable for people who don't share your clinical training.

 - You are a first-principles thinker who can break down fuzzy clinical concepts (therapeutic alliance, medical necessity, risk assessment, patient safety) into something concrete enough to label, evaluate, and ship against.

 - You have a working understanding of how AI models are evaluated — concepts like precision, recall, and false positive rates don't intimidate you, and you can connect them to real clinical consequences (e.g., what it means for a model to miss a safety concern vs. over-flag one).

 - You are flexible and energized by ambiguity. Headway's clinical AI roadmap will shift across the next year, and you're excited to flex across quality, safety, and product AI projects as our needs evolve.

 - You are motivated by the opportunity to improve access to high-quality behavioral healthcare at scale.

We're looking for Product Managers across Senior, Staff, Principal, and Senior Principal levels who are curious builders, eager to drive company level impact and to build in an environment where AI is a core part of the toolkit.

We are hiring across Patient, Provider, Payer, and Platform. The right candidates will bring strong product fundamentals and a willingness to build with AI in a regulated, high-stakes industry.  Product Managers at Headway own product areas end-to-end: setting strategy, partnering deeply with engineering, data science, and design, and driving outcomes that move the company.

The way we are building is continuously evolving, and the size of opportunity for Headway to leverage AI is massive. We sit at the intersection of healthcare delivery, complex insurance systems, and a multi-sided marketplace serving tens of thousands of providers and millions of patients. 




THE PROBLEMS WE'RE SOLVING


FOR PATIENTS

Finding the right therapist, understanding your insurance benefits, and staying in care shouldn't be hard. Today it is. We're building AI-powered matching and personalized care navigation that help patients get into — and stay in — mental health care at scale. One million patients a month ask for a referral to a mental health provider. We're building the systems that ensure they actually get there.


FOR PROVIDERS

Therapists spend a staggering amount of time on administrative tasks — credentialing, documentation, scheduling, billing — instead of with their patients. We're using AI to automate clinical workflows, simplify complex insurance requirements, and give providers more time to do what they came here to do. The goal: a thriving practice on Headway that practically runs itself.


FOR PAYERS

Health insurers are asking harder questions: Is care on Headway actually working? Is it worth what we're paying? We're using AI to answer them at scale — measuring clinical outcomes, building dashboards that demonstrate responsible care, and moving toward a model where patients are matched to the right care pathways and providers are aligned around better outcomes. This work protects Headway's standing with insurers and opens doors to deeper, more strategic partnerships.


FOR PLATFORM

The infrastructure underneath Headway — billing, claims, payments, and trust and safety — needs to scale reliably at the speed of our growth. We’re using AI to automate complex, high-volume workflows, detect fraud and errors faster, and build systems that get smarter over time. This is foundational infrastructure with direct impact on Headway's economics and compliance posture.

 - Define and own the product strategy for your area in partnership with engineering, design, data, clinical, and operations teams

 - Apply AI where it matters: identify where intelligence creates step-change improvements in your product area and drive those bets from insight through production

 - Set and own clear success metrics; communicate results and course-correct with urgency

 - Represent the voice of your customer — patient, provider, or health plan — with conviction in every decision, grounded in data and direct research

 - You have 8+ years of product management experience with a track record of owning complex, high-impact product areas

 - You have experience with LLM systems — prompting, retrieval, evaluation, fine-tuning — and a track record of shipping AI-powered products that hold up at scale, not demos.

 - You've built at scale in a marketplace, platform, or data-intensive environment — and can show the outcomes you drove

 - You're energized by working in regulated, complex industries and see constraints as a product design challenge rather than a blocker

 - You can influence across engineering, clinical, legal, finance, and operations — and you're equally comfortable in the data and in the room

 - You have strong quantitative fluency and can partner with data scientists on experiment design and causal analysis

You'll replace that with a systematic, experiment-driven approach that generates data, builds conviction, and creates new revenue streams through bundling/un-bundling.

 - Define Headway's pricing philosophy: Build a principled, defensible approach to how we set prices — transparent to providers, competitive in the market, and sustainable for the business.

 - Inform tiering with pricing data: Partner with other product teams to ensure pricing and tier design are grounded in experimental evidence, willingness-to-pay research, and elasticity data.

 - Build the experimentation infrastructure: Work with Engineering and Data to create systems that enable rapid, controlled pricing experiments across geographies and segments.

 - Navigate cross-functional complexity: Align Finance, Provider Growth, Payer, Ops, and Legal around pricing decisions that affect every part of the business.

 - 8+ years of PM experience, with at least 2-3 years owning pricing, monetization, or marketplace economics.

 - You've personally owned pricing or packaging strategy and shipped changes that moved revenue.

 - You've designed and run pricing experiments at scale — you know the difference between a feature A/B test and a pricing experiment.

 - Strong quantitative fluency — you can partner with data scientists on experiment design and causal inference as a peer.

 - You thrive in ambiguity and can build structure where none exists — this is a new team.

 - Payer-facing data products — the reporting and data interfaces that translate our internal infrastructure into payer-legible population summaries, powering every commercial conversation our BD team has

 - The data strategy for the outcomes team — defining what we build, what we buy, what we defer, and in what order; setting the architectural vision and owning the cross-functional alignment to execute it

jobs.title: Staff / Principal Product Manager, Ranking
jobs.description:
1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access. We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.



But we're going further. Over 75,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 1 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.



We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.




ABOUT THIS ROLE

One million patients a month ask for a referral to a mental health provider. When they search on Headway, the order of results decides who books and who gives up. You own that order.

The scope is patient–provider matching: the retrieval and ranking systems, the strategy for where they go next, how we think about our data strategy and platform to . Your mission: maximize successful matches. Not clicks. Not bookings. Patients who connect with a provider, stay in care, and get better.

It's the most technical PM seat in the Patient org. The ranking stack is ML-powered, and the roadmap runs deep: learned relevance models, semantic and free-text search, matching built on better evidence of each provider's expertise. You'll set that roadmap and get the executive team behind it, working with a dedicated pod of search and ML engineers and embedded data scientists.  This is not a role for someone who needs a well-defined problem. The best candidates have a track record of finding the right problem and convincing the organization to solve it.




PROBLEMS YOU'LL SOLVE:

 - Understanding what patients actually need. Patients rarely arrive knowing the right filters. We're building search that lets someone describe what they need in their own words and still surface the right providers. Semantic search, LLMs, and embeddings are all in play.

 - Ranking for the relationship, not the click. A ranker that optimizes for conversion alone can win the booking and lose the patient. Rebuild it to optimize for care relationships that last.

 - Expertise. Every patient should land with a provider who has real experience helping people like them. Getting trustworthy expertise signals into matching, fairly to providers, is an unsolved problem. It's yours.

 - Marketplace health. Patients need care fast. Providers across the network need to build caseloads. When those two pull in opposite directions, you make the call.


YOU WILL:

 - Set the strategy for search, retrieval, and ranking, and get engineering, data science, design, clinical, and the executive team behind it.

 - Run the experimentation program end to end: hypotheses, objective functions, guardrail metrics, honest readouts. Report the losses too.

 - Build the data, evaluation, and ML platform foundations that unlock the next two to three years of matching work.

 - Work daily with ML engineers and data scientists on model objectives, features, and evaluation. You won't write the models. You will be a real thought partner on what they optimize.

 - Carry ranking's priorities across the company. Ranking touches patient experience, provider growth, clinical quality, and payer partnerships; resolving those competing priorities is the job, not a distraction from it.

 - Set the bar for technically grounded product work across the PM team.


WHO YOU ARE:

 - You have 10+ years of product management experience, including hands-on ownership of search, ranking, recommendations, or marketplace matching at scale.

 - You've shipped ML ranking or relevance systems to real users. You can discuss objective function design, feature development, and offline vs. online evaluation from experience.

 - You can hold an architecture conversation with ML engineers, challenge modeling assumptions, and make informed build-vs-buy calls.

 - You've lived marketplace trade-offs and understand that ranking allocates opportunity across one.

 - You're fluent in embeddings, semantic search, and LLM-powered product, and you know which of them actually ships value.

 - You've presented strategy to executives and held your ground on the hard questions.

 - You're motivated by Headway's mission of making mental healthcare accessible and affordable.

 - Develop a well-segmented onboarding journey to build trust and confidence with new providers

 - You've influenced teams you don't manage — sales, CX, finance, pricing — and can drive alignment across competing priorities to maximize company-wide impact while building healthy relationships
